The '''Ahakista system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]].
